comment: The audio jacks carry whatever is patched to them, so no family is set for them. The unipolar 5V offset is applied only in the branch taken when the modulation jack is unpatched; patching a modulation jack silently drops it, so in the unipolar setting the lower threshold shifts down by 5V and the upper threshold is pinned to 5V when its attenuator is at 0. Folding is a single reflection, out = 2 * threshold - out, not repeated. Both attenuators are configured with the name "Attenuation for Upper Threshold Modulation" and both threshold knobs with the name "Volt".
